{{include reference="ReleaseNotes.Code.EntryVelocityMacros"/}} {{velocity output="false"}} #set ($exclusions = "$!wikimacro.parameters.exclusions") #set ($exclusions = $exclusions.split('\s*,\s*')) #set ($changesLimit = "$!wikimacro.parameters.limit") ## With migrationNotes="true", the macro displays the backward compatibility and migration notes of the release note ## instead of its changes. Each block below displaying the changes is guarded by this flag, since a block cannot keep ## the blocks after it from running. #set ($migrationNotesOnly = "$!wikimacro.parameters.migrationNotes" == 'true') #macro (removeExcludedChanges $changes) #set ($discard = $changes.removeAll($exclusions)) #end ## Each section is a page of changes, so it can leave changes out. Say so rather than let a release note look ## complete while it is not: this is the only sign an author gets that the limit needs raising. #macro (displayTruncationWarning $hasMore $miscHasMore) #if ($hasMore || $miscHasMore) (% class="box warningmessage" %)((( {{translation key="releasenotes.changes.truncated"/}} ))) #end #end ## Displays the migration notes of one audience, under the heading of that audience, and nothing when it has none. #macro (displayMigrationNotesSection $audienceKey $changes $variableName $hasMore) #if ($changes.size() > 0) == {{translation key="releasenotes.changes.${audienceKey}.heading"/}} == {{displayChanges displayer="migrationNotes" displayEditLink="$displayEditLink" contextVariable="$variableName"/}} #displayTruncationWarning($hasMore false) #end #end {{/velocity}} {{velocity}} ## The versions the changes are gathered from: a milestone or a release candidate gathers its own changes, whereas ## a final release note also gathers the ones of its milestones and of its release candidates. They are derived ## from the page name, which has to be named using the short version syntax, e.g. "8.3M1". #set ($versionsParameter = $stringtool.join($services.releasenotes.getAggregatedVersions($doc.documentReference), ',')) ## Extract product + version + released info from xobject #set ($product = $!doc.getValue('product')) #set ($version = $!doc.getValue('version')) #set ($released = $!doc.getValue('released')) ## The product and the versions are placed into the getChanges calls below as macro parameter values, which are ## re-parsed as wiki syntax, so both must be emitted escaped: left raw, a value carrying a double quote would ## close the parameter and the rest of the value would be parsed as wiki syntax of its own. The versions are ## escaped only once the milestone/RC/final parsing above has built them, since that parsing works on the raw ## page name. #set ($escapedProduct = $services.rendering.escape("$!product", 'xwiki/2.1')) #set ($escapedVersions = $services.rendering.escape($versionsParameter, 'xwiki/2.1')) ## Decide whether or not display edit links for changes: only display them when the current user has edit rights on ## the current page #set ($displayEditLink = $hasEdit) #if (!$migrationNotesOnly) == {{translation key="releasenotes.changes.user.heading"/}} == ## Handle the action only under the same condition that shows its button: the current user can edit the note and ## the note is not released. The button being hidden otherwise is not by itself what keeps the action from running. #if ($hasEdit && $released != '1' && "$!request.action" == 'useradd' && $services.csrf.isTokenValid($request.getParameter('form_token'))) #handleAddAction($product, $version, "${request.queryString}&xredirect=$doc.getURL('view')") #end #if ($hasEdit && $released != '1') {{html clean='false'}}
{{/html}} #end #end {{/velocity}} {{velocity}} #if (!$migrationNotesOnly) {{getChanges limit="$changesLimit" products="$escapedProduct" versions="$escapedVersions" types="Change" audience="user" containsScreenshots="true" contextVariable="userChanges"/}} #end {{/velocity}} {{velocity}} #if (!$migrationNotesOnly) {{getChanges limit="$changesLimit" products="$escapedProduct" versions="$escapedVersions" types="Change" audience="user" containsScreenshots="false" contextVariable="userMiscChanges"/}} #end {{/velocity}} {{velocity}} #if (!$migrationNotesOnly) #removeExcludedChanges($userChanges) #removeExcludedChanges($userMiscChanges) #if ($userChanges.size() == 0) #if ($userMiscChanges.size() == 0) {{translation key="releasenotes.changes.user.nochanges"/}} #else {{displayChanges displayer="list" displayEditLink="$displayEditLink" contextVariable="userMiscChanges"/}} #end #else {{displayChanges displayer="simple" displayEditLink="$displayEditLink" contextVariable="userChanges"/}} #if ($userMiscChanges.size() > 0) === {{translation key="releasenotes.changes.user.miscellaneous"/}} === {{displayChanges displayer="list" displayEditLink="$displayEditLink" contextVariable="userMiscChanges"/}} #end #end #displayTruncationWarning($userChangesHasMore, $userMiscChangesHasMore) == {{translation key="releasenotes.changes.admin.heading"/}} == #if ($hasEdit && $released != '1' && "$!request.action" == 'adminadd' && $services.csrf.isTokenValid($request.getParameter('form_token'))) #handleAddAction($product, $version, "${request.queryString}&xredirect=$doc.getURL('view')") #end #if ($hasEdit && $released != '1') {{html clean='false'}}
{{/html}} #end #end {{/velocity}} {{velocity}} #if (!$migrationNotesOnly) {{getChanges limit="$changesLimit" products="$escapedProduct" versions="$escapedVersions" types="Change" audience="administrator" containsScreenshots="true" contextVariable="adminChanges"/}} #end {{/velocity}} {{velocity}} #if (!$migrationNotesOnly) {{getChanges limit="$changesLimit" products="$escapedProduct" versions="$escapedVersions" types="Change" audience="administrator" containsScreenshots="false" contextVariable="adminMiscChanges"/}} #end {{/velocity}} {{velocity}} #if (!$migrationNotesOnly) #removeExcludedChanges($adminChanges) #removeExcludedChanges($adminMiscChanges) #if ($adminChanges.size() == 0) #if ($adminMiscChanges.size() == 0) {{translation key="releasenotes.changes.admin.nochanges"/}} #else {{displayChanges displayer="list" displayEditLink="$displayEditLink" contextVariable="adminMiscChanges"/}} #end #else {{displayChanges displayer="simple" displayEditLink="$displayEditLink" contextVariable="adminChanges"/}} #if ($adminMiscChanges.size() > 0) === {{translation key="releasenotes.changes.admin.miscellaneous"/}} === {{displayChanges displayer="list" displayEditLink="$displayEditLink" contextVariable="adminMiscChanges"/}} #end #end #displayTruncationWarning($adminChangesHasMore, $adminMiscChangesHasMore) == {{translation key="releasenotes.changes.developer.heading"/}} == #if ($hasEdit && $released != '1' && "$!request.action" == 'devadd' && $services.csrf.isTokenValid($request.getParameter('form_token'))) #handleAddAction($product, $version, "${request.queryString}&xredirect=$doc.getURL('view')") #end #if ($hasEdit && $released != '1') {{html clean='false'}}
{{/html}} #end #end {{/velocity}} {{velocity}} #if (!$migrationNotesOnly) {{getChanges limit="$changesLimit" products="$escapedProduct" versions="$escapedVersions" types="Change" audience="developer" importance="Medium,High" contextVariable="devChanges"/}} #end {{/velocity}} {{velocity}} #if (!$migrationNotesOnly) {{getChanges limit="$changesLimit" products="$escapedProduct" versions="$escapedVersions" types="Change" audience="developer" importance="Low" contextVariable="devMiscChanges"/}} #end {{/velocity}} {{velocity}} #if (!$migrationNotesOnly) #removeExcludedChanges($devChanges) #removeExcludedChanges($devMiscChanges) #if ($devChanges.size() == 0) #if ($devMiscChanges.size() == 0) {{translation key="releasenotes.changes.developer.nochanges"/}} #else {{displayChanges displayer="list" displayEditLink="$displayEditLink" contextVariable="devMiscChanges"/}} #end #else {{displayChanges displayer="simple" displayEditLink="$displayEditLink" contextVariable="devChanges"/}} #if ($devMiscChanges.size() > 0) === {{translation key="releasenotes.changes.developer.miscellaneous"/}} === {{displayChanges displayer="list" displayEditLink="$displayEditLink" contextVariable="devMiscChanges"/}} #end #end #displayTruncationWarning($devChangesHasMore, $devMiscChangesHasMore) #end {{/velocity}} {{velocity}} #if ($migrationNotesOnly) {{getChanges limit="$changesLimit" products="$escapedProduct" versions="$escapedVersions" audience="user" types="Migration" contextVariable="userMigrationNotes"/}} {{getChanges limit="$changesLimit" products="$escapedProduct" versions="$escapedVersions" audience="administrator" types="Migration" contextVariable="adminMigrationNotes"/}} {{getChanges limit="$changesLimit" products="$escapedProduct" versions="$escapedVersions" audience="developer" types="Migration" contextVariable="developerMigrationNotes"/}} #end {{/velocity}} {{velocity}} #if ($migrationNotesOnly) ## A migration note is added the way a change is, from a page the release note takes for it, and only differs from a ## change by the type of its entry, which the form of the new entry carries along. The audience is left for the ## author to choose in that form, a migration note being as often for administrators as for developers. #if ($hasEdit && $released != '1' && "$!request.action" == 'migrationadd' && $services.csrf.isTokenValid($request.getParameter('form_token'))) #handleAddAction($product, $version, "${request.queryString}&xredirect=$doc.getURL('view')") #end #if ($hasEdit && $released != '1') {{html clean='false'}}
{{/html}} #end #removeExcludedChanges($userMigrationNotes) #removeExcludedChanges($adminMigrationNotes) #removeExcludedChanges($developerMigrationNotes) #if ($userMigrationNotes.isEmpty() && $adminMigrationNotes.isEmpty() && $developerMigrationNotes.isEmpty()) {{translation key="releasenotes.changes.migrationNotes.none"/}} #else #displayMigrationNotesSection('user' $userMigrationNotes 'userMigrationNotes' $userMigrationNotesHasMore) #displayMigrationNotesSection('admin' $adminMigrationNotes 'adminMigrationNotes' $adminMigrationNotesHasMore) #displayMigrationNotesSection('developer' $developerMigrationNotes 'developerMigrationNotes' $developerMigrationNotesHasMore) #end #end {{/velocity}}

property.description: A comma separated list of changes to exclude.
Maximum number of changes to display in each section of the release note. A section holding more changes than that says so, and raising this is what displays them all.
"true" to display the backward compatibility and migration notes of the release note, grouped by audience, instead of its changes.
